Name: Narendra Modi
PastRecord: Served as Prime Minister of India since 2014; implemented digital initiatives and major infrastructure projects.
ElectionPromises: Viksit Bharat by 2047, continued focus on self-reliance, national security, and digital empowerment.

Name: Rahul Gandhi
PastRecord: Former President of the Indian National Congress; led the Bharat Jodo Yatra to connect with grassroots.
ElectionPromises: Nyay scheme for minimum income guarantee, filling government vacancies, and focus on social justice and MSMEs.

Name: Arvind Kejriwal
PastRecord: Chief Minister of Delhi; implemented models for subsidized electricity, water, and improved public schools (Mohalla Clinics).
ElectionPromises: Expansion of the Delhi model nationwide, focusing on free healthcare, world-class education, and anti-corruption.

Name: Mamata Banerjee
PastRecord: Chief Minister of West Bengal since 2011; ended 34-year Left Front rule; implemented various social welfare schemes like Kanyashree.
ElectionPromises: Defense of regional autonomy, expansion of welfare schemes for women and farmers, and strong opposition to CAA/NRC.

Name: Akhilesh Yadav
PastRecord: Former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh; initiated major expressway projects and laptop distribution schemes for students.
ElectionPromises: PDA (Pichhde, Dalit, Alpasankhyak) empowerment, caste census, and massive youth employment drives in UP.
